label: For "Public Sector Agent Action Guardrails": Limit and record what AI agents do inside benefit systems, citizen records and payment runs so that every decision affecting a resident has a named human owner and a record an ombudsman can review. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Direct edit rights across case systems.
